files.pit_totals.py:
"""Print the per-pit sheet for Cranlow Cooperage.

Reads every monthly export in casks/ (one row per cask firing) and
prints one line per pit, in name order, followed by a totals line:

    <pit>,<firings>,<minutes>
    TOTAL,<firings>,<minutes>
"""

import glob

import pandas as pd

frames = []
for path in sorted(glob.glob("casks/*.csv")):
    frames.append(pd.read_csv(path))

df = pd.concat(frames)
for pit, group in df.groupby("pit"):
    print(f"{pit},{len(group)},{int(group['minutes'].sum())}")
print(f"TOTAL,{len(df)},{int(df['minutes'].sum())}")

pit_totals.py prints the per-pit sheet the yard office reads out
at the end of the week. The yard office terminal has no third-party
packages; standard library only.
